name: Rewrite Actions
author: Ghost Typist
description: Rewrite, shorten, expand, change tone, simplify, translate, fix grammar, or remove filler in a selection.

actions.title: Rewrite
actions.instruction: Rewrite the text to read more clearly while preserving its meaning. Return only the rewritten text.

actions.title: Shorten
actions.instruction: Make the text more concise without losing meaning. Return only the shortened text.

actions.title: Expand
actions.instruction: Elaborate on the text with a little more detail, in the same voice. Return only the expanded text.

actions.title: Change Tone
actions.instruction: Rewrite the text in a {argument} tone, preserving meaning. Return only the rewritten text.

actions.title: Simplify
actions.instruction: Rewrite the text so it is easier to understand, using plain language. Return only the simplified text.

actions.title: Translate
actions.instruction: Translate the text into {argument}. Return only the translation.

actions.title: Fix Grammar
actions.instruction: Correct spelling, grammar and punctuation. Change nothing else. Return only the corrected text.

actions.title: Remove Filler
actions.instruction: Remove filler words and redundancy. Keep the meaning and voice. Return only the tightened text.
